archetypes.name: oos-retry
archetypes.rationale: OOS retry matching and checkpoint ordering are the highest-risk behavior changes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on python/oos_filer.py and its tests. Check that checkpoint-visible evidence is written before the disposition checkpoint, success markers are only written after checkpoint success, and persisted evidence cannot duplicate public issue creation on retry. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: runlog-step9a1
archetypes.rationale: Several run-log consumers must agree on provisional ndjson semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review run_logs.py, audit_runs.py, pr_body.py, docs/run-logs.md, and skills/implement/SKILL.md together. Verify that oos-issues.ndjson alone is treated as provisional and that run-statistics.md or explicit step9a1=true remains the completion signal. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: design-wrapper
archetypes.rationale: The new shell harness and autofix wrapper audit row alter prompt-script contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review design-step1d5 collect coverage and design-step-validator-autofix ok-path audit behavior. Check idempotent launch-failure logging, dirty-tree recovery env output, final-status gating, and the mandatory --site append-failure invocation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
